exceptions.name: brotli-decompressor
exceptions.reason: Upstream documents corrected error handling for inputs that trigger CVE-2026-111497 in the C decoder. This is security hardening; it is not a claim that the Rust implementation shares the C decoder RCE.

exceptions.name: brotli
exceptions.reason: Requires brotli-decompressor >=6.2 and therefore brings the documented decoder security hardening into Tauri asset compression/decompression.
